measurement_notes: No rerender was performed to write this verification record. Artifact byte sizes were read from the completed outputs.

Timing values are the recorded run values in whole milliseconds. Memory values below are retained rounded measurements from the run notes; they are explicitly approximate, not reconstructed exact raw logs.
Stress measurements were taken while other workspace validation activity was occurring. Latency and memory are hardware- and load-dependent.
All size values named mib use 1024 * 1024 bytes; benchmark stdout historically labels these values mb.

sample.fixture: Precision assembly / training review; 3 steps, 9 criteria, 3 evidence frames, 2 exceptions, 3 manual preparation checks. Illustrative fixture, not a live account snapshot.

native_pdf.result: All pages inspected: clear hierarchy, readable text, intact photographs and metadata, no clipping or overlap.

html_print.result: All pages inspected after fixing section kicker/title fragmentation: headings retained together, evidence images present, no clipping or overlap.

responsive_html.visual_inspection: All three viewport screenshots inspected; mobile statistics wrap to a readable 2-by-2 grid and evidence cards stack without horizontal overflow.

maximum.file_budget: PDF and offline HTML each remain below the frontend 30 MB prepared-file limit. Long documents retain all supplied information; a 2939-page synthetic maximum is not a typical report.

stress.limits_and_memory_caveat: The PDF scheduler admits one active worker and two queued snapshots, uses a 30-second overall deadline and supports cancellation. The worker V8 old-generation heap limit is 384 MB; it does not cap native buffers, shared allocations, or whole-process RSS. The reported main-thread heap is not worker heap. Peak whole-process RSS is an observed high-water mark including worker/native allocations, not a memory-limit guarantee. Saved account snapshots have a separate 2 MB limit.
